name: Ironsoul's Condemnors
inspire: Immediately after making an Attack roll or Save roll for a friendly fighter, if that roll included any {icon:crit}, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Bulwark against the Dark
reactions.flavorText: The Condemnors stand firm against the horrors of the realms.
reactions.rulesText: Friendly fighters with no Move and/or Charge tokens cannot be driven back.

abilities.name: Punishing Blow
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you a pick weapon as part of an Attack by a friendly Brodus.
abilities.flavorText: Brodus's Greatmace charges up with celestial energy.
abilities.rulesText: That weapon has +X Attack dice, where X is equal to the battle round. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Aetherically Charged Shield
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your opponent picks a weapon as part of an Attack that targets a friendly shield aetheric ({icon:shield-aetheric}).
abilities.flavorText: With potent celestial magic, the Sequitors' shields light ablaze with cerulean power.
abilities.rulesText: Weapon abilities cannot be used for that Attack. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Aetherically Charged Maul
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after you pick a weapon as part of an Attack by a friendly shield aetheric ({icon:shield-aetheric}).
abilities.flavorText: Weapons crackling with power, the Sequitors blast the enemy to smoking ruin.
abilities.rulesText: That weapon has + 1 Range for that Attack. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Three durable Stormcast elites with 5 Health each and steady but slow Move 3, inspiring whenever their Attack or Save rolls include a critical success. Inspired, the shield-bearers gain stronger Saves plus Cleave or Stagger, while Brodus gains speed and dice for his Grievous greatmace, and once per game can add dice equal to the battle round. Standing fighters cannot be driven back, and once-per-game shield and maul tricks negate weapon abilities or extend reach. The warband wins by holding objectives and grinding down anyone who closes in.
